name: soft-paper-ui
description: A complete, reversible design system (warm paper-white surfaces, pill buttons, serif headings, blue controls, amber warnings, custom toasts and modals, automatic dark mode) inspired by the Claude Android app. Use this skill whenever the user asks to apply, install, switch on, restyle with, or reverse "the theme", "the design system", "soft paper", "Claude-style UI", or asks for any web page or app screen, form, button, modal, toast, banner, loader, list, settings page, navigation, table or dark
